Looking at my starting hand:
- **Canopy Stalker** {3}{G} – solid creature with evasion and life gain
- **Clockwork Hydra** {5} – interesting mana sink with repeatable damage
- **Feral Prowler** {1}{G} – early drop with card draw value
- **Scale the Heights** {2}{G} – flexible utility spell with card draw mode
- **3x Forest** – mana

This is a reasonable opening hand. I have two creatures that can apply early pressure (Feral Prowler, Canopy Stalker), good mana acceleration (3 Forests), and utility in both Clockwork Hydra and Scale the Heights. The distribution is solid - enough lands to cast my spells, and the creatures have good synergy with the support cards.

I'll **keep** this hand.

annotations.description: Kept a hand of 7 lands (4 Forest, 3 Mountain) with zero spells. This hand has no ability to affect the board and will lose to any opponent who plays spells. Even a mulligan to 6, 5, or even 4 cards with at least some spells would be vastly better than keeping 7 lands.
annotations.betterLine: Mulligan aggressively. Any hand with even 1-2 spells and some lands would be dramatically better than 7 lands.

annotations.description: Timed out and failed to play a land, missing a land drop with 5 lands in hand. This prevented casting Hunter's Edge (4 mana) this turn, which could have removed Pouncing Cheetah or Feral Prowler. It also delays Affectionate Indrik by a full turn.
annotations.actionTaken: No response — skipped the land drop entirely.
annotations.betterLine: Play a Forest to reach 4 mana, then cast Hunter's Edge targeting an opposing creature to gain tempo and board control.

annotations.description: Haiku Sport timed out and failed to cast Benevolent Hydra, which was the only available action. With 4 Forests untapped, they could cast it for X=2 as a 3/3. While casting postcombat would actually be slightly better sequencing (since it has summoning sickness anyway), the timeout suggests they may miss the cast entirely this turn. The Hydra's counter-boosting ability synergizes excellently with their hand (Soul's Might, Enlarge) and existing board (+1/+1 counter on Feral Prowler).
annotations.actionTaken: Timed out without casting Benevolent Hydra
annotations.betterLine: Cast Benevolent Hydra for X=2 (postcombat main would be ideal sequencing, but casting it at all is important for board development and synergy with counter-based cards in hand)

annotations.description: At 5 life facing multiple opposing creatures (Canopy Stalker 4/2, Pouncing Cheetah 3/2, Feral Prowler 2/4, Benevolent Hydra 2/2), the player timed out and did nothing. They missed playing a land AND casting Orazca Frillback (4/2), which was a desperately needed blocker. The opponent's creatures will untap and threaten lethal next turn.
annotations.actionTaken: Timed out, passing the turn with no plays made - no land drop, no creature cast.
annotations.betterLine: Play a Forest (land drop), then cast Orazca Frillback for {2}{G} to have a 4/2 blocker. This is critical for survival at 5 life against the opponent's board.
